snippet.title: ½ Halfway - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/halfway/id1503427023
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.crevasse.halfway

In a world dominated by black and white, two elements are seeking a path to reunite and restore harmony. Guide the light elements to destination and meet halfway using the help of the other objects strategically placed across the level and prove incredible puzzle-solving skills by succeeding in mind-bending situations.

Halfway features:
· Challenging handcrafted levels grouped into 4 chapters.
· Play Offline, no internet connection required to play.
· Beautiful, minimalist artwork & animations.
· True black and white graphics.
· No violence, stress-free; play at your own pace.
· No ads, no in-app purchases. Buy it once, own it forever.
· Simple controls, Swipe to move
· Easy to learn; no instructions needed!
· Haptic Feedback
· Optimized for all iOS devices.
